mapper.select: SELECT review_no, request_no, sitter_email, writer_email, rating, content, reg_time FROM tbl_babysitter_review WHERE sitter_email = #{sitterEmail} ORDER BY reg_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_babysitter_review (request_no, sitter_email, writer_email, rating, content) VALUES (#{requestNo}, #{sitterEmail}, #{writerEmail}, #{rating}, #{content})
